name: Derivation Fixture
_comment: A synthetic, FONTLESS kit that exists only to exercise lib/render/palette.mjs.
It is deliberately not a client kit: the template repo must never need one to
run its own tests. Three well-separated identity hues, so slot capacity is
greater than the declared hue count and the derivation ladder is actually
exercised. Change these hex values and the pinned hexes in palette.test.mjs
